title: Postgres Query-Tuning Plan
description: A structured plan for a Postgres query-tuning session, so evidence capture, fix ordering, and this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/postgres_explain_analyzer_audit.mjs.

symptom.description: The observed problem shape, per this skill's decision diagram.

explainCaptured.description: True if EXPLAIN ANALYZE output for the actual query has been captured (not guessed).

buffersIncluded.description: True if the captured plan used the BUFFERS option so shared hit/read I/O is visible.

plannedFixes.description: The fixes this session intends to apply, in order.

environment.description: Where the fixes will be applied. Production index builds must be CONCURRENTLY.

scanType.description: The dominant scan node in the captured plan.

tableRowCount.description: Approximate row count of the main table in the plan (pg_class.reltuples).

estimateVsActualRatio.description: How far off the planner's row estimate is from actual rows (max(est/actual, actual/est)). >= 10 means statistics need fixing first.

sortSpillsToDisk.description: True if any Sort/Hash node in the captured plan shows 'external merge Disk'.

deadTupleRatio.description: n_dead_tup / n_live_tup for the hot table. > 0.2 requires autovacuum tuning.

indexDropJustified.description: True if any planned DROP INDEX has 30 days of idx_scan evidence plus an EXPLAIN showing affected queries hit a different index.

usesConcurrently.description: True if planned index builds use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.

verifiedAfterFix.description: True if the plan commits to re-running EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) after the fix to confirm the node change.
